title: A comment says WHY, and names the measurement
description: The convention this repository actually follows in code it keeps: a comment records the defect the line prevents and what was measured, not a restatement of the line.
statement: A comment explains why the code is as it is — the defect it prevents, the alternative that was tried, the number that was measured. Never a paraphrase of what the line already says.
rationale: This repository's own modules are unusually heavily commented and the comments earn it: `ci-gates.ts` records the 27-of-33 miscount that produced it, `known-skills.ts` records the silent drop. A comment restating the code goes stale invisibly, because nothing contradicts it; a comment naming a measurement can be checked and can be wrong out loud.
